subject: English
question_text: Read the beginning of a story. Write ten new sentences
stimulus: to complete the story. 1×10=10 Once upon a time there lived a rich man who had a big mango orchard. A caretaker named Bahadur looked after that orchard. One day some friends of the rich man came to him to pay a visit. The rich man asked Bahadur to bring sweet mangoes for his friends...........................
guide_solution: Story writing Once upon a time there lived a rich man who had a big mango orchard. A caretaker named Bahadur looked afar that orchard. Once day some friends of the rich man came to him to pay a visit . The rich man asked Bahadur to bring sweet mangoes for his friends. Bahadur went to the mango orchard and brought some ripe mangoes. He gave the mangoes to the friends of the rich man to eat. They started eating the mangoes but the mangoes tasted sour. Again Bahadur was asked to bring some sweet mangoes and as a result, he went to the orchard again and brought some mangoes. The guests began to eat and this time also, the mangoes tasted sour. At this the owner of the orchard became angry. But Bahadur remained clam and quiet. He respectfully replied that he was appointed to take care of the garden and not to taste the mangoes. As he did not taste the mangoes, he didn't know which mangoes are sour or which mangoes are sweet. The owner of the orchard became astonished at the honesty of Bahadur. As a result, the rich man rewarded Bahadur amply for which he became very happy.  Title : honesty is always rewarded
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 130 — SOS Hermann Gmeiner College, Dhaka
